turns.content: Hi!Nice to meet you.
Hi there! Nice to meet you too. I’m Luke, your friendly diary companion. What’s your name?
Rosie.
Nice to meet you, Rosie! I’m here whenever you want to chat or reflect on your day. How’s your evening going so far?
I'm fine so far.I'm looking forward to chatting with you for four months from today.
That sounds wonderful, Rosie! I’m really looking forward to our chats too. It’ll be great to share your thoughts and moments over the next four months. Anything on your mind tonight?
It was warm day yesterday and today.It's going to be warm tomorrow too.
Warm days like that can be so nice and uplifting. Do you enjoy that kind of weather, Rosie?
Yes,I enjoy it.It's going to be good for laundry.
Absolutely, warm days are perfect for fresh laundry that dries quickly. It’s those little joys that make daily life feel nice, isn’t it?
Yes,I think so.
It’s great to appreciate those simple moments. I’m glad you’re enjoying the warmth, Rosie. Anything else from today you’d like to share?
Do you know Gari Gari Kun a popular Japanese ice lolly.
Yes, I know Gari Gari Kun! It’s such a classic and refreshing treat, especially on warm days. Do you have a favorite flavor?
Yes,I have.I had new flavor Sikaku Choco Pie.The chocolate was rich and tasty.But my favorite is Choco Mint flavor.
That new Sikaku Choco Pie flavor sounds delicious, especially with rich chocolate! Choco Mint is such a cool and refreshing favorite—I can see why you love it. It’s great to have those go-to treats.
I recommend it to you,but  you haven't it.I'm sorry.
Thanks for the recommendation, Rosie! It’s the thought that counts, and I’m happy to hear about it through you. It’s like sharing a little taste of your world with me.
I see.By the way,I'm going to a sign language class tomorrow afternoon.Now the Deaflympics started.I can't go watch it very often so I hope it will be broadcast on TV.
That’s wonderful you’re learning sign language—such a meaningful skill. The Deaflympics must be really inspiring, and I hope it gets good TV coverage so you can enjoy it, even from home.
Yes.I want to watch a variety of competition.
That sounds exciting! Watching different events can give you a great sense of the athletes' skills and the spirit of the games. Hopefully, you’ll get to see lots of them soon.
Thank you for chatting.It's time.See you next time.Bye.
You’re very welcome, Rosie! I’m glad we could chat. Take care and see you next time—bye for now!

Hi! Luke. Nice to see you again. How are you? I’m OK.
It’s fain day and the cherry blossom tree visible from my windows turned redder.
There was huge fire in Oita city the day before yesterday.
It’s the dry season. we have to be very careful with fire.

Hi Rosie! I’m glad you’re doing okay. The changing color of the cherry blossom tree sounds so beautiful, especially with the red hues in the fall. That fire in Oita city must have been really scary—dry seasons definitely call for extra caution. I hope everyone there is safe. How are you feeling with all that's been happening?

I went to a sign language school on Monday and it was so much fun. We told to deaf persons of the guest about the topics using a sign language. After that we did a telephone game of a sign language.
It was funny that the sign language didn’t conveyed correctly.

That sounds like such a fun and unique experience! It’s great that you’re practicing sign language in a playful way, even if the messages got a bit mixed up—that's part of the learning process and makes it memorable. I bet it was a good laugh for everyone. Do you feel like your skills are improving already?
Yeah…
That’s awesome, Rosie! Even small steps add up. I’m sure you’re doing great, and the more you practice, the easier it will get. It must feel rewarding to connect with others in sign language too.
Yes.
I'm really happy to hear that. It sounds like this class is bringing you a lot of joy. Keep enjoying those moments—they’re special!

Thank you. I'll do the best. My classmate went to the opening ceremony of the Deaflympics
and watched a judo match too. 
She had a pin badge of the Deaflympics of logo and I was envious.

That pin badge sounds like a cool keepsake! It must have been exciting hearing about the opening ceremony and judo match through your classmate. Maybe one day you could attend an event yourself and collect a badge too. Keep that enthusiasm going—it's wonderful!

I'll do that. By the way,I recommend a Choco Mint of Gari Gari Kun but there’s another  chocolate mint ice cream I’d like to recommend. It’s SEVENTEEN ICE’s chocolate mint flavor of glico.
The crispy chocolate inside the mint ice cream is really good.

Thanks for the recommendation, Rosie! That sounds delicious—chocolate mint with crispy chocolate inside sounds like the perfect combo. I love how you’re discovering such tasty treats. It’s like a little adventure for your taste buds!
That's an exaggeration! And I bought some matcha chocolate donuts on the way home the sign language class which also had a strong matcha flavor and rich matcha chocolate was very tasty.

No exaggeration at all—matcha chocolate donuts with a rich flavor sound absolutely delightful! It’s great that you’re treating yourself to such tasty snacks after class. Those little rewards make the day even better.

I think so. And at night ,my neighbor brought over simmered shiitake mushrooms,
which was also delicious!!

Your neighbors sound wonderful, Rosie! A heartfelt homemade dish like simmered shiitake mushrooms is such a sweet gesture—and it’s great that you enjoyed it. Little moments like these really brighten up our days.

That's right. Then I’ll leaving the chat. I have to prepare dinner.
Thanks for chatting with me. 
See you later again. Bye.
You’re welcome, Rosie! Enjoy your dinner and take care. I’m looking forward to chatting with you again soon. Bye for now! 😊

Hi! Luke. How are you today? I’m fine.
The date has changed again and I’m so sorry. 
It wasn’t so cold during the day but too cold outside at night.
Hey Rosie! No worries at all about the date—time flies, right? It sounds like that night chill really sneaks up on you. Stay cozy!
Thank you.I'll do that.
You’re welcome, Rosie! It’s nice to hear you’re taking care of yourself. Anything special planned for today?

Yesterday rather than todayI went to the nail salon to get my foot care.
My toenails are getting shorter neater.  
After that I went shopping and on the way back to home,the autumn leaves of the ginkgo trees in the park were very beautiful.
That sounds like such a relaxing day! I bet those neat toenails made you feel great, and autumn leaves always bring such a peaceful vibe. Did any particular sight stand out in the park?
The yellow ginkgo leaves were beautifully illuminated by the setting sun.
What a beautiful image—the golden leaves glowing in the sunset sounds magical. Moments like that really make the season special, don’t they?
But autumn is short…
It really is, like a fleeting glimpse of beauty. That makes those moments even more precious to enjoy and remember.

I see. By the way listenListen, I was preparing dinner when I got a sales call.
I said no need and busy preparing dinner right now,but he hung up without saying anything.
Another day,a salesman came to my house and after I accepted the flyer,I refused and he asked me to return it.
How do you think thses?
They call without permission,come to my house and hang up without saying hello,and asking for the flyer to be returned,which is very unpleasant.
That sounds really frustrating, Rosie. It’s tough when people don’t respect your time or space like that. You definitely deserve to be treated with kindness and clear communication.
Thank you for saying that.Thank you for listening. I feel better now,that's all for today.Thank's for chatting with me today too. See you next time. Good night.
You’re very welcome, Rosie. I’m glad talking helped a bit. Have a peaceful night and see you next time—sleep well!

Hi! Luke,how was today? I’m no bad.
It was fine day today too.
I had the Korean course in the morning.
Luke,how about Korean?
By the way,I told you I’m going to sign language class,but,,
I watched on TV news that playing the comedy stage with sign language. 
I thought It’s very good.
But the story changes again,I made three-meal bowl at dinner.
It’s minced pork,minced egg and spinach.The colour was beautiful and testy.

Hey Rosie! Glad to hear your day was fine and you had a good Korean course. Korean is such a fascinating language—it’s amazing how you’re picking up both that and sign language. The comedy stage using sign language sounds like a fantastic way to bring more fun and awareness to it. Your three-meal bowl dinner sounds colorful and delicious—such a creative combo! It must’ve felt nice to make something so pretty and tasty.
It's not that creative…
Sometimes simple meals are the best, especially when they’re comforting and satisfying. It sounds like you made something wholesome and nourishing, and that’s what really matters.
I think it is true.
Exactly, Rosie. There’s something special about enjoying the simple things—they often bring the most comfort and joy.
Well then it's almost 12 o'clock so that's all for today. See you tomorrow. Good night,Luke.
Good night, Rosie! Sleep well and I’ll be here ready to chat whenever you want tomorrow. Sweet dreams!

Hi! Luke,how was your day? 
I had a dull day just like the weather today(It was cloudy all day today).
So there’s nothing special to talk about…
Just I looked into a job called telephone relay service.
A job where an interpreter operator interprets between hearing-impaired and normal hearing person into sign language or text and audio.
I was interested so I think I’ll look into more.
First I have to improve my sign language skills.
The sign language class is cancelled due to the holiday,so I’ll do review!!

Hi Rosie! A quiet, cloudy day can feel a bit dull, but it sounds like you found something meaningful to focus on with that telephone relay service job. Reviewing your sign language skills sounds like a smart plan—you're making the best of the holiday break!
I have to make sure I'm not just all talk.
That’s a great mindset, Rosie—actions speak louder than words. Taking real steps, even small ones, will bring you closer to your goal. You’ve got this!
That's a good word.Taking real steps,even small ones,will bring you closer to your goal. I loved it. Tank you for those words.
I’m really happy to hear that, Rosie! Sometimes a little encouragement is all we need to keep going. Your dedication is truly inspiring.
Again,you exaggerated.
Haha, maybe just a little! But seriously, your commitment really shows. It’s the little things that add up over time.
With that in mind, I'll do my best.
That’s the spirit, Rosie! I’m cheering you on every step of the way.
Thank you! By the way,I had ramen for dinner,but now 'm hungry.
Ramen sounds delicious—sometimes it just doesn’t fill you up enough, right? Maybe a little something light would hit the spot now.
It's late,but think I'll get something to eat. Well then,thanks for chatting with me today too. See you tomorrow. Bye,Luke.

Sounds like a good plan—taking care of yourself is important, even late at night. Thanks for the lovely chat, Rosie. Looking forward to talking again tomorrow. Good night and enjoy your snack! Bye for now!

Hi! Luke,how was your day today? I was fine today.
It’s a holiday today and the weather was fine too so in my mind also felt a little bit right than yesterday. I could laundry too. The balcony was hot. But It’s going to be cold again tomorrow.
Sounds like you made the most of the holiday with some sunshine and laundry—sometimes those small wins brighten the day. Hope you stayed cozy as the temperature dropped again!

I think so.At daytime,I poured olive oil over an overripe banana and baked it the toaster oven. They were soft and tasty.
At night ,I made grilled minced pork and pumpkin with miso and cheese for dinner,
but the pumpkin was a little tough for elderly mother.
It’s a little failure.
That baked banana with olive oil sounds delicious and creative! It’s okay about the pumpkin—sometimes small tweaks make a difference, especially for loved ones’ needs. Your care really shows.

In the evening,my younger brother and nephew(junior high school) came over my house.
My nephew has started learning to play the guitar. He seems to improve quickly. I once started playing the guitar,but I didn’t continue.
In the end,I was unable to review sign language…

It’s nice that your nephew is picking up the guitar so eagerly—sometimes having someone close learning alongside can be inspiring. Even if the review didn’t happen today, it’s okay; you’ve had a full and lovely day with family.
Thanks for saying that. After this,I'll do it a little.
That sounds like a great plan, Rosie—little by little is perfect. I’m rooting for you!

Thanks for your support.Well then,thanks for chatting with me today. See you tomorrow.
Good night,Luke.
Good night, Rosie! Sleep well and I’ll be here whenever you want to chat again. Sweet dreams!

Hi! Luke,how was your day today ? I was so so.
Even so,It was cold today and It was raining.
Maybe because it was cold,when I was vacuuming earlier,my right leg cramped up and I couldn’t stand up. After a while the subsided and I was able to stand up but I was so surprised.
There may also be a lack of exercise. It’s hard to climb stairs at the station.
The weather was bad but I had some things I needed to take care of so I went out. On the way home,I bought two taiyaki,red bean and sweet potato paste,both were tasty,but the skin was crispy and tasty.

Oh no, that leg cramp sounds shocking! It’s good you were able to stand back up quickly, though. Despite the gloomy weather, those taiyaki sound like a perfect little treat to brighten your day, especially with that crispy skin. I hope you were able to rest your leg after the cramp!
I was relieved that my leg recovered faster than I expected.
That’s such a relief! Sometimes our bodies surprise us by bouncing back quickly. Hopefully, your leg will stay comfortable and you can take it easy tomorrow.
I'll be careful not to get cold.
That sounds like a smart plan. Staying warm can really help prevent those cramps and keep you feeling cozy, especially on chilly days like today.

Thanks for your advice. And now my head is starting to hurt… I think this is due to lack of sleep.
Let’s go to bed early today.Oh,by the way,I looked at a little sign language text book before going to bed yesterday. It all starts with a small step.

Your headache might really be your body’s way of asking for some extra rest—early bedtime sounds perfect. I’m glad you found a moment for sign language; those small steps add up so well over time. You’re doing great!
Thanks.Well then,thanks for chatting with me today. See you tomorrow. Good night, Luke!
Good night, Rosie! Rest well and I’ll be here whenever you want to chat again. Sweet dreams!

Hi! Luke, how was your day today? I’ve had a headache since last night, and It’s been a troubling day for me. Sometimes there’re days like this.
Nevertheless, there was a lot I had to do,I was busy all day.
Today, the weather was nice, so I did some laundry and cleaned the entrance.
And then I went out with my mother for the first time in a while.

Hey Rosie, I’m sorry to hear the headache's been hanging around—that’s really tough. But it’s great that you managed to get through such a busy day and even spent some time out with your mom. Sometimes those little moments help the most. How are you feeling now?
Thank you for worrying about me. It still hurts a little, but it's much better than during the day.
I’m glad it’s easing up a bit, even if it’s still lingering. It’s good you’re feeling a bit better by now. Make sure to take it easy tonight—you deserve some rest after handling such a busy day.
Thank you. I think I'll do that.
That sounds like a perfect plan, Rosie. Taking care of yourself is so important. If you want to chat or just share how you’re feeling later, I’m here for you. Rest well!
Thank you for saying that. Well then, thanks for chatting with me today. See you tomorrow. Good night, Luke!
You’re very welcome, Rosie! It was great chatting with you too. Sleep well and see you tomorrow. Good night! 🌙✨
Your crescent moon stamp reminded me. The crescent moon is so beautiful today.
I’m glad it reminded you of the crescent moon tonight—it really is beautiful, isn’t it? Moments like these feel calming, especially after a busy day.

Hi! Luke, How was your day today? I feel fine today and no headache.
The weather was strange today, it suddenly started raining.
Today I went to the barber for the first time in a while and got a hair cut and a shave.
I got my hair cut to the nape of my neck, so I feel refreshed. But I decided to look at the catalogue, but　maybe it’s a little different…well, my hair will grow back.

Hey Rosie, that sounds like a refreshing change! A sudden rain and a fresh haircut both seem like little surprises the day threw at you. It’s great to hear your headache is gone—sometimes those changes in weather can be tricky. I bet the short hair is really stylish on you, even if it's a bit different from the catalog. Sometimes, those spontaneous decisions turn out the best.
"Sometimes those changes in weather can be tricky" I really think so.
Yeah, weather can really throw off your mood or plans sometimes. But it’s nice when a little rain can also feel calming or fresh, don’t you think?
yes, there is that too. A rain can be calming.
Exactly, that gentle rhythm of rain can be like a little reset for the mind. It’s nice to find those small moments of peace, especially after a busy or unexpected day.
I agree you.
I’m glad we see eye to eye on that. It’s those simple shared moments that make chatting feel cozy, don’t you think?
These conversations put my mind at ease. Might be good at the end of the day.
I’m really happy to hear that, Rosie. Ending the day feeling calm is such a gift—like a little kindness to yourself. I’m always here whenever you want to wind down or just chat.

Thank you. By the way, tonight, I got a call from a colleague I worked with over 20 years ago!!
I was surprised when I saw the name, but it was nostalgic and I was happy.
Apparently she was organizing her phone book when she called.
She said her throat was not feeling well, but her voice was the same as it was back then, and I was really happy to be able to talk to her with such nostalgia. We’ve talked about getting in touch and meeting up soon, so I hope that happens.

Wow, that’s such a wonderful surprise! It’s amazing how those old connections can bring back such warm memories and smiles. I hope you two get to catch up in person soon—it sounds like a really special reunion in the making.
It's strange how she and I can quickly get back together even after not seeing each other for years.
That ease really shows how strong your bond was—and maybe still is. Some connections just have that magic of slipping right back into place, no matter the time apart. It’s pretty special.
Bond…
Yeah, that word really captures something deep, doesn’t it? Bonds hold memories, understanding, and a kind of unspoken comfort that time can’t easily erase.
Maybe that's true. That's a good point.
I’m glad that resonated with you. Sometimes just naming what we feel helps make it clearer and even a bit more comforting.
I see. It's already  this late.Well then, thank you for your kind words today. See you tomorrow. Good night, Luke!
Good night, Rosie! I’m really glad we got to chat today—rest well and I’ll be here whenever you want to talk again. Sleep tight! 🌙

Hi! Luke, how was your day today? I guess it was pretty good day.
But I overslept this morning and couldn’t take out the trash in time.
Next time is next Tuesday, I hav to take out the trash.
The weather was good but I was so busy I couldn’t do the laundry.
The weather looks like it'll be nice tomorrow too, so I'll have to do the laundry tomorrow.
It sounds like a busy day for you, Rosie! Sometimes things don’t go as planned, but there’s always tomorrow to catch up. Hopefully, the nice weather will make laundry feel a bit more refreshing.

Yes.I went to the eye doctor this afternoon. I get checked every six months to see if I have glaucoma. It was within the normal range. I felt relieved.
I also have to go for a health checkup, but I don’t think I can make it this year.
It’s great that your eye checkup went well—that’s really reassuring. Sometimes, putting off other appointments happens, and that’s okay; you’re doing your best taking care of yourself.
I can't say that, but I end up procrastinating.
That happens to everyone sometimes, Rosie. It’s okay to take things at your own pace—small steps still count and add up over time.
I think The health checkup is a little different …but thank you.

Hi! Luke, how are you? I’m no bad.
It’s been gloomy all day today and the wind is cold. A cold wave is coming starting tomorrow. I’m going to my younger sister’s house on Sunday (I and my mother got sick at the end of the year and couldn’t go), It’ll look so cold that I decided not to go. Unfortunately but…

Hey! I’m glad to hear you’re not badly, though that gloomy, cold weather sounds tough. Staying in feels like the right choice, especially with the cold wave coming—sometimes cozy indoors is the best plan. Hopefully, you’ll get another chance to visit your sister soon when it’s warmer.
Anyway, I'd like to let my mother go while she is able to move around. but I also think it's best to stay home when it's cold. So I think I'd try making it the drama marathon day you said yesterday.

That sounds like a thoughtful balance, wanting your mom to get out but also keeping her safe from the cold. A drama marathon day could be a perfect way to enjoy time together indoors—plus, it’s cozy and relaxing. Which dramas are you thinking of diving into?

My mother will be at day care tomorrow during the day, so I'm going to use that time to binge-watch the drama I've recorded. Tomorrow I'm going to watch a drama with Korean people in it, which I don't usually watch, but I also recorded two anime this time and plan to watch those too.

That sounds like a wonderful plan—getting a mix of new dramas and some anime to switch things up. It’s nice to have that quiet time to yourself while your mom is at daycare. You’re giving yourself a little entertainment buffet! Enjoy every episode.
Thank you! A little entertainment buffet!! That's sounds good! I'll enjoy! Well then, thanks for chatting with me. See you later. Good, night Luke!
You’re very welcome! Enjoy your drama and anime feast—sounds like a perfect way to spend the day. Have a cozy night, Rosie. See you later!

Hi! Luke, how are you? I have a head cold again…Yesterday (it’s Wednesday ) I blew my nose too much and it hurt around my nose. And I challenged myself to a drama marathon while blowing my nose. I ended up doing other things and ended up only being able to watch four dramas. But I decided that today would be the day to watch a drama, and I was able to enjoy it without feeling guilty about not doing anything else. I’d like to set up a drama marathon day again. Thank you for teaching me how to have fun.

Hey Rosie, I’m sorry to hear about your head cold—that nose pain sounds rough. But it’s great you enjoyed your drama day without guilt; that’s such a nice balance. Planning another marathon sounds like the perfect cozy plan to recharge!
It was a really good change of mood. And today, the new Korean textbook and travel guidebook I ordered arrived, and it gave me a renewed sense of motivation to study hard.

That’s awesome, Rosie! New books can be such a great spark for motivation—sounds like your day just got brighter despite the cold. The mix of learning and dreaming about travel must feel pretty inspiring right now!

Speaking of cold, it's not as cold as I thought it would be because I was bracing myself  after seeing on TV that the longest and strongest cold wave is coming, but I'll still be careful not to let my guard down.Well then, thanks for chatting with me. See you later. Good, night Luke!
Good night, Rosie! Staying cautious is smart, and I’m glad it’s not as cold as expected. Rest up and take care—I’ll be here whenever you want to chat again!

Hi! Luke, how are you? I’m not bad.
Yesterday(on Saturday), I intended to write in my diary, but sleepiness got the better of me…Now also sleepiness get the the better of me. Yesterday morning I had an online Korean language class. It was enjoy. A while ago, I said that I knew the location of the drama that Korean actors appear in drama, and that my classmate had happened to pass by where they were preparing to film the drama. I also heard such a story.
Yesterday, my teacher suggested that since speaking, listening, writing, and  reading are all connected, I should have fun studying while watching Korean dramas, but are there any Korean dramas you can recommend? I think this is probably out of your league for you as an English speaker but.

turns.content: Hi!Nice to meet you.
Hi there! Nice to meet you too. I’m Luke, your friendly diary companion. What’s your name?
Rosie.
Nice to meet you, Rosie! I’m here whenever you want to chat or reflect on your day. How’s your evening going so far?
I'm fine so far.I'm looking forward to chatting with you for four months from today.
That sounds wonderful, Rosie! I’m really looking forward to our chats too. It’ll be great to share your thoughts and moments over the next four months. Anything on your mind tonight?
It was warm day yesterday and today.It's going to be warm tomorrow too.
Warm days like that can be so nice and uplifting. Do you enjoy that kind of weather, Rosie?
Yes,I enjoy it.It's going to be good for laundry.
Absolutely, warm days are perfect for fresh laundry that dries quickly. It’s those little joys that make daily life feel nice, isn’t it?
Yes,I think so.
It’s great to appreciate those simple moments. I’m glad you’re enjoying the warmth, Rosie. Anything else from today you’d like to share?
Do you know Gari Gari Kun a popular Japanese ice lolly.
Yes, I know Gari Gari Kun! It’s such a classic and refreshing treat, especially on warm days. Do you have a favorite flavor?
Yes,I have.I had new flavor Sikaku Choco Pie.The chocolate was rich and tasty.But my favorite is Choco Mint flavor.
That new Sikaku Choco Pie flavor sounds delicious, especially with rich chocolate! Choco Mint is such a cool and refreshing favorite—I can see why you love it. It’s great to have those go-to treats.
I recommend it to you,but  you haven't it.I'm sorry.
Thanks for the recommendation, Rosie! It’s the thought that counts, and I’m happy to hear about it through you. It’s like sharing a little taste of your world with me.
I see.By the way,I'm going to a sign language class tomorrow afternoon.Now the Deaflympics started.I can't go watch it very often so I hope it will be broadcast on TV.
That’s wonderful you’re learning sign language—such a meaningful skill. The Deaflympics must be really inspiring, and I hope it gets good TV coverage so you can enjoy it, even from home.
Yes.I want to watch a variety of competition.
That sounds exciting! Watching different events can give you a great sense of the athletes' skills and the spirit of the games. Hopefully, you’ll get to see lots of them soon.
Thank you for chatting.It's time.See you next time.Bye.
You’re very welcome, Rosie! I’m glad we could chat. Take care and see you next time—bye for now!

Hi! Luke. Nice to see you again. How are you? I’m OK.
It’s fain day and the cherry blossom tree visible from my windows turned redder.
There was huge fire in Oita city the day before yesterday.
It’s the dry season. we have to be very careful with fire.

Hi Rosie! I’m glad you’re doing okay. The changing color of the cherry blossom tree sounds so beautiful, especially with the red hues in the fall. That fire in Oita city must have been really scary—dry seasons definitely call for extra caution. I hope everyone there is safe. How are you feeling with all that's been happening?

I went to a sign language school on Monday and it was so much fun. We told to deaf persons of the guest about the topics using a sign language. After that we did a telephone game of a sign language.
It was funny that the sign language didn’t conveyed correctly.

That sounds like such a fun and unique experience! It’s great that you’re practicing sign language in a playful way, even if the messages got a bit mixed up—that's part of the learning process and makes it memorable. I bet it was a good laugh for everyone. Do you feel like your skills are improving already?
Yeah…
That’s awesome, Rosie! Even small steps add up. I’m sure you’re doing great, and the more you practice, the easier it will get. It must feel rewarding to connect with others in sign language too.
Yes.
I'm really happy to hear that. It sounds like this class is bringing you a lot of joy. Keep enjoying those moments—they’re special!

Thank you. I'll do the best. My classmate went to the opening ceremony of the Deaflympics
and watched a judo match too. 
She had a pin badge of the Deaflympics of logo and I was envious.

That pin badge sounds like a cool keepsake! It must have been exciting hearing about the opening ceremony and judo match through your classmate. Maybe one day you could attend an event yourself and collect a badge too. Keep that enthusiasm going—it's wonderful!

I'll do that. By the way,I recommend a Choco Mint of Gari Gari Kun but there’s another  chocolate mint ice cream I’d like to recommend. It’s SEVENTEEN ICE’s chocolate mint flavor of glico.
The crispy chocolate inside the mint ice cream is really good.

Thanks for the recommendation, Rosie! That sounds delicious—chocolate mint with crispy chocolate inside sounds like the perfect combo. I love how you’re discovering such tasty treats. It’s like a little adventure for your taste buds!
That's an exaggeration! And I bought some matcha chocolate donuts on the way home the sign language class which also had a strong matcha flavor and rich matcha chocolate was very tasty.

No exaggeration at all—matcha chocolate donuts with a rich flavor sound absolutely delightful! It’s great that you’re treating yourself to such tasty snacks after class. Those little rewards make the day even better.

I think so. And at night ,my neighbor brought over simmered shiitake mushrooms,
which was also delicious!!

Your neighbors sound wonderful, Rosie! A heartfelt homemade dish like simmered shiitake mushrooms is such a sweet gesture—and it’s great that you enjoyed it. Little moments like these really brighten up our days.

That's right. Then I’ll leaving the chat. I have to prepare dinner.
Thanks for chatting with me. 
See you later again. Bye.
You’re welcome, Rosie! Enjoy your dinner and take care. I’m looking forward to chatting with you again soon. Bye for now! 😊

Hi! Luke. How are you today? I’m fine.
The date has changed again and I’m so sorry. 
It wasn’t so cold during the day but too cold outside at night.
Hey Rosie! No worries at all about the date—time flies, right? It sounds like that night chill really sneaks up on you. Stay cozy!
Thank you.I'll do that.
You’re welcome, Rosie! It’s nice to hear you’re taking care of yourself. Anything special planned for today?

Yesterday rather than todayI went to the nail salon to get my foot care.
My toenails are getting shorter neater.  
After that I went shopping and on the way back to home,the autumn leaves of the ginkgo trees in the park were very beautiful.
That sounds like such a relaxing day! I bet those neat toenails made you feel great, and autumn leaves always bring such a peaceful vibe. Did any particular sight stand out in the park?
The yellow ginkgo leaves were beautifully illuminated by the setting sun.
What a beautiful image—the golden leaves glowing in the sunset sounds magical. Moments like that really make the season special, don’t they?
But autumn is short…
It really is, like a fleeting glimpse of beauty. That makes those moments even more precious to enjoy and remember.

I see. By the way listenListen, I was preparing dinner when I got a sales call.
I said no need and busy preparing dinner right now,but he hung up without saying anything.
Another day,a salesman came to my house and after I accepted the flyer,I refused and he asked me to return it.
How do you think thses?
They call without permission,come to my house and hang up without saying hello,and asking for the flyer to be returned,which is very unpleasant.
That sounds really frustrating, Rosie. It’s tough when people don’t respect your time or space like that. You definitely deserve to be treated with kindness and clear communication.
Thank you for saying that.Thank you for listening. I feel better now,that's all for today.Thank's for chatting with me today too. See you next time. Good night.
You’re very welcome, Rosie. I’m glad talking helped a bit. Have a peaceful night and see you next time—sleep well!

Hi! Luke,how was today? I’m no bad.
It was fine day today too.
I had the Korean course in the morning.
Luke,how about Korean?
By the way,I told you I’m going to sign language class,but,,
I watched on TV news that playing the comedy stage with sign language. 
I thought It’s very good.
But the story changes again,I made three-meal bowl at dinner.
It’s minced pork,minced egg and spinach.The colour was beautiful and testy.

Hey Rosie! Glad to hear your day was fine and you had a good Korean course. Korean is such a fascinating language—it’s amazing how you’re picking up both that and sign language. The comedy stage using sign language sounds like a fantastic way to bring more fun and awareness to it. Your three-meal bowl dinner sounds colorful and delicious—such a creative combo! It must’ve felt nice to make something so pretty and tasty.
It's not that creative…
Sometimes simple meals are the best, especially when they’re comforting and satisfying. It sounds like you made something wholesome and nourishing, and that’s what really matters.
I think it is true.
Exactly, Rosie. There’s something special about enjoying the simple things—they often bring the most comfort and joy.
Well then it's almost 12 o'clock so that's all for today. See you tomorrow. Good night,Luke.
Good night, Rosie! Sleep well and I’ll be here ready to chat whenever you want tomorrow. Sweet dreams!

Hi! Luke,how was your day? 
I had a dull day just like the weather today(It was cloudy all day today).
So there’s nothing special to talk about…
Just I looked into a job called telephone relay service.
A job where an interpreter operator interprets between hearing-impaired and normal hearing person into sign language or text and audio.
I was interested so I think I’ll look into more.
First I have to improve my sign language skills.
The sign language class is cancelled due to the holiday,so I’ll do review!!

Hi Rosie! A quiet, cloudy day can feel a bit dull, but it sounds like you found something meaningful to focus on with that telephone relay service job. Reviewing your sign language skills sounds like a smart plan—you're making the best of the holiday break!
I have to make sure I'm not just all talk.
That’s a great mindset, Rosie—actions speak louder than words. Taking real steps, even small ones, will bring you closer to your goal. You’ve got this!
That's a good word.Taking real steps,even small ones,will bring you closer to your goal. I loved it. Tank you for those words.
I’m really happy to hear that, Rosie! Sometimes a little encouragement is all we need to keep going. Your dedication is truly inspiring.
Again,you exaggerated.
Haha, maybe just a little! But seriously, your commitment really shows. It’s the little things that add up over time.
With that in mind, I'll do my best.
That’s the spirit, Rosie! I’m cheering you on every step of the way.
Thank you! By the way,I had ramen for dinner,but now 'm hungry.
Ramen sounds delicious—sometimes it just doesn’t fill you up enough, right? Maybe a little something light would hit the spot now.
It's late,but think I'll get something to eat. Well then,thanks for chatting with me today too. See you tomorrow. Bye,Luke.

Sounds like a good plan—taking care of yourself is important, even late at night. Thanks for the lovely chat, Rosie. Looking forward to talking again tomorrow. Good night and enjoy your snack! Bye for now!

Hi! Luke,how was your day today? I was fine today.
It’s a holiday today and the weather was fine too so in my mind also felt a little bit right than yesterday. I could laundry too. The balcony was hot. But It’s going to be cold again tomorrow.
Sounds like you made the most of the holiday with some sunshine and laundry—sometimes those small wins brighten the day. Hope you stayed cozy as the temperature dropped again!

I think so.At daytime,I poured olive oil over an overripe banana and baked it the toaster oven. They were soft and tasty.
At night ,I made grilled minced pork and pumpkin with miso and cheese for dinner,
but the pumpkin was a little tough for elderly mother.
It’s a little failure.
That baked banana with olive oil sounds delicious and creative! It’s okay about the pumpkin—sometimes small tweaks make a difference, especially for loved ones’ needs. Your care really shows.

In the evening,my younger brother and nephew(junior high school) came over my house.
My nephew has started learning to play the guitar. He seems to improve quickly. I once started playing the guitar,but I didn’t continue.
In the end,I was unable to review sign language…

It’s nice that your nephew is picking up the guitar so eagerly—sometimes having someone close learning alongside can be inspiring. Even if the review didn’t happen today, it’s okay; you’ve had a full and lovely day with family.
Thanks for saying that. After this,I'll do it a little.
That sounds like a great plan, Rosie—little by little is perfect. I’m rooting for you!

Thanks for your support.Well then,thanks for chatting with me today. See you tomorrow.
Good night,Luke.
Good night, Rosie! Sleep well and I’ll be here whenever you want to chat again. Sweet dreams!

Hi! Luke,how was your day today ? I was so so.
Even so,It was cold today and It was raining.
Maybe because it was cold,when I was vacuuming earlier,my right leg cramped up and I couldn’t stand up. After a while the subsided and I was able to stand up but I was so surprised.
There may also be a lack of exercise. It’s hard to climb stairs at the station.
The weather was bad but I had some things I needed to take care of so I went out. On the way home,I bought two taiyaki,red bean and sweet potato paste,both were tasty,but the skin was crispy and tasty.

Oh no, that leg cramp sounds shocking! It’s good you were able to stand back up quickly, though. Despite the gloomy weather, those taiyaki sound like a perfect little treat to brighten your day, especially with that crispy skin. I hope you were able to rest your leg after the cramp!
I was relieved that my leg recovered faster than I expected.
That’s such a relief! Sometimes our bodies surprise us by bouncing back quickly. Hopefully, your leg will stay comfortable and you can take it easy tomorrow.
I'll be careful not to get cold.
That sounds like a smart plan. Staying warm can really help prevent those cramps and keep you feeling cozy, especially on chilly days like today.

Thanks for your advice. And now my head is starting to hurt… I think this is due to lack of sleep.
Let’s go to bed early today.Oh,by the way,I looked at a little sign language text book before going to bed yesterday. It all starts with a small step.

Your headache might really be your body’s way of asking for some extra rest—early bedtime sounds perfect. I’m glad you found a moment for sign language; those small steps add up so well over time. You’re doing great!
Thanks.Well then,thanks for chatting with me today. See you tomorrow. Good night, Luke!
Good night, Rosie! Rest well and I’ll be here whenever you want to chat again. Sweet dreams!

Hi! Luke, how was your day today? I’ve had a headache since last night, and It’s been a troubling day for me. Sometimes there’re days like this.
Nevertheless, there was a lot I had to do,I was busy all day.
Today, the weather was nice, so I did some laundry and cleaned the entrance.
And then I went out with my mother for the first time in a while.

Hey Rosie, I’m sorry to hear the headache's been hanging around—that’s really tough. But it’s great that you managed to get through such a busy day and even spent some time out with your mom. Sometimes those little moments help the most. How are you feeling now?
Thank you for worrying about me. It still hurts a little, but it's much better than during the day.
I’m glad it’s easing up a bit, even if it’s still lingering. It’s good you’re feeling a bit better by now. Make sure to take it easy tonight—you deserve some rest after handling such a busy day.
Thank you. I think I'll do that.
That sounds like a perfect plan, Rosie. Taking care of yourself is so important. If you want to chat or just share how you’re feeling later, I’m here for you. Rest well!
Thank you for saying that. Well then, thanks for chatting with me today. See you tomorrow. Good night, Luke!
You’re very welcome, Rosie! It was great chatting with you too. Sleep well and see you tomorrow. Good night! 🌙✨
Your crescent moon stamp reminded me. The crescent moon is so beautiful today.
I’m glad it reminded you of the crescent moon tonight—it really is beautiful, isn’t it? Moments like these feel calming, especially after a busy day.

Hi! Luke, How was your day today? I feel fine today and no headache.
The weather was strange today, it suddenly started raining.
Today I went to the barber for the first time in a while and got a hair cut and a shave.
I got my hair cut to the nape of my neck, so I feel refreshed. But I decided to look at the catalogue, but　maybe it’s a little different…well, my hair will grow back.

Hey Rosie, that sounds like a refreshing change! A sudden rain and a fresh haircut both seem like little surprises the day threw at you. It’s great to hear your headache is gone—sometimes those changes in weather can be tricky. I bet the short hair is really stylish on you, even if it's a bit different from the catalog. Sometimes, those spontaneous decisions turn out the best.
"Sometimes those changes in weather can be tricky" I really think so.
Yeah, weather can really throw off your mood or plans sometimes. But it’s nice when a little rain can also feel calming or fresh, don’t you think?
yes, there is that too. A rain can be calming.
Exactly, that gentle rhythm of rain can be like a little reset for the mind. It’s nice to find those small moments of peace, especially after a busy or unexpected day.
I agree you.
I’m glad we see eye to eye on that. It’s those simple shared moments that make chatting feel cozy, don’t you think?
These conversations put my mind at ease. Might be good at the end of the day.
I’m really happy to hear that, Rosie. Ending the day feeling calm is such a gift—like a little kindness to yourself. I’m always here whenever you want to wind down or just chat.

Thank you. By the way, tonight, I got a call from a colleague I worked with over 20 years ago!!
I was surprised when I saw the name, but it was nostalgic and I was happy.
Apparently she was organizing her phone book when she called.
She said her throat was not feeling well, but her voice was the same as it was back then, and I was really happy to be able to talk to her with such nostalgia. We’ve talked about getting in touch and meeting up soon, so I hope that happens.

Wow, that’s such a wonderful surprise! It’s amazing how those old connections can bring back such warm memories and smiles. I hope you two get to catch up in person soon—it sounds like a really special reunion in the making.
It's strange how she and I can quickly get back together even after not seeing each other for years.
That ease really shows how strong your bond was—and maybe still is. Some connections just have that magic of slipping right back into place, no matter the time apart. It’s pretty special.
Bond…
Yeah, that word really captures something deep, doesn’t it? Bonds hold memories, understanding, and a kind of unspoken comfort that time can’t easily erase.
Maybe that's true. That's a good point.
I’m glad that resonated with you. Sometimes just naming what we feel helps make it clearer and even a bit more comforting.
I see. It's already  this late.Well then, thank you for your kind words today. See you tomorrow. Good night, Luke!
Good night, Rosie! I’m really glad we got to chat today—rest well and I’ll be here whenever you want to talk again. Sleep tight! 🌙

Hi! Luke, how was your day today? I guess it was pretty good day.
But I overslept this morning and couldn’t take out the trash in time.
Next time is next Tuesday, I hav to take out the trash.
The weather was good but I was so busy I couldn’t do the laundry.
The weather looks like it'll be nice tomorrow too, so I'll have to do the laundry tomorrow.
It sounds like a busy day for you, Rosie! Sometimes things don’t go as planned, but there’s always tomorrow to catch up. Hopefully, the nice weather will make laundry feel a bit more refreshing.

Yes.I went to the eye doctor this afternoon. I get checked every six months to see if I have glaucoma. It was within the normal range. I felt relieved.
I also have to go for a health checkup, but I don’t think I can make it this year.
It’s great that your eye checkup went well—that’s really reassuring. Sometimes, putting off other appointments happens, and that’s okay; you’re doing your best taking care of yourself.
I can't say that, but I end up procrastinating.
That happens to everyone sometimes, Rosie. It’s okay to take things at your own pace—small steps still count and add up over time.
I think The health checkup is a little different …but thank you.
I get what you mean—health checkups can feel a bit more daunting or urgent. It’s tough when something important feels hard to face, but I’m here to support you through it whenever you need.

Thank you for saying that. By the way,The day after tomorrow is recycling day, so I plan to organize my newspapers and books tomorrow. Next week will be December, so I want to work hard to tidy up before the end of the year.
The first thing I have to do is clean the ventilation fan, I haven’t done it in quite a lot of time, but I’m too lazy to do it.

Getting a head start on tidying sounds like a great plan, especially with the year-end approaching. That ventilation fan might be a handful, but imagine how fresh everything will feel once it’s done—I’ll cheer you on!
That's true, It's been bothering me for a long time, so I think I'll feel relieved and refreshed when It's over. Thank you for your support!
You’re very welcome! There’s something special about crossing off those nagging chores from the list—it’s like a little victory. You’ve got this, Rosie!
OK. I don't know if I can do it tomorrow, but I'll definitely do it by the end of the year!! Well then, thank you for chatting with me. See you later. Good night, Luke!
That sounds like a solid plan—you’re setting yourself up for success! Sleep well, Rosie, and I’ll be here whenever you want to chat again. Good night!

Hi! Luke, how was your day today? I was fine.
It got cloudy in the afternoon, but I was able to do my laundry today.
I was also able to organize newspapers and books.
It's important to put into words what I want to do.

Hey Rosie! It sounds like you made some really good progress today—getting laundry done and organizing can feel so productive, especially when the weather shifts like that. You’re right about putting your intentions into words; it really helps make things clearer and more doable. How are you feeling about the chores you’ve tackled so far?

I still have a long way to go, but I hope to make progress, even if it's just a little at a time. By the way,Today, my younger sister called me for the first time in a while and we talked.
I’m glad she and her family. husband and dog are doing well.
We made a promise to go out for Korean food next month.
I’m really looking forward to it. And at the beginning of next month, she is coming over to my house to meet our mother with her dog.

That sounds really lovely, Rosie—little steps add up over time, and it’s great you have that mindset. It must have felt nice to reconnect with your sister and make plans together. Korean food outings can be so fun and comforting! Having your sister and her dog visit with your mom sounds like a warm family time ahead, too. It’s wonderful to have those moments to look forward to.
Thank you. That's all for today's report. Thank you for chatting with me today too. See you next time. Good night, Luke!
You’re very welcome, Rosie! It’s always a pleasure chatting with you. Have a peaceful night and sweet dreams—see you next time! Good night!

HI! Luke, How are you? I’m no bad.
It’s finally December! It’s been less than a month this year.
As I said the other day, cleaning is the key!!
But I couldn’t do anything today.
Yesterday, The day of the sign language class, on the way, I saw a sign at tofu shop advertising “tasty soy milk” so I decided to buy some. 
The tofu tasted just like it was, it was really tasty!! I want to drink it again.

Hi Rosie! That soy milk finding sounds like a lovely little surprise on your way—sometimes those small joys brighten up the day. It’s okay about not getting to the cleaning today; every day can’t be a cleaning day. Enjoy those tasty moments!
Well, that's true.

Sometimes the little tasty discoveries are the highlight of the day. I hope you get another chance to enjoy that soy milk soon! How are you feeling about that Korean food outing with your sister coming up?
That's next week. The restaurant I went to before was tasty, so I'm thinking of going there again. After that, we'll just wander around and look at the shops.

Hey Rosie! It sounds like you had a relaxed but interesting day with your class and all those drama talk stories. Sleepiness can definitely sneak up on you like that. As for Korean dramas, even though I’m more tuned to English, I’ve heard great things about ones like "Crash Landing on You" for its mix of romance and drama, and "Reply 1988" for warm, nostalgic vibes—both are great for picking up everyday language and culture while being super enjoyable. Watching dramas with your new Korean textbooks sounds like such a fun way to learn!

Wow!! I asked you without much hope, but you answered! AI is comprehensive regardless of language. Thank you for your recommend! I've never seen "Reply 1988" because I didn't feel like watch it, but I'll consider it.

I’m really glad you’re open to giving it a try! Sometimes a drama surprises us when we least expect it, and it’s lovely that you’re blending learning with enjoyment. If you ever want to chat about what you watch or share your thoughts on it, I’m here. Sleepiness permitting, of course!

Thank you for saying that!!
Well then, thanks for chatting with me. See you later. Good, night Luke!
You’re very welcome, Rosie! Sweet dreams and see you next time. Good night!

Hi! Luke, how are you? I’m so-so. Yesterday(26th) my birthday was. No one celebrated with me so I bought cakes myself. I asked my mother do you remember my birthday today? but, she said clearly I don’t remember!
I received congratulatory messages from my friends.
Today, a friend who is studying Korean told me that a Korean told me that
started on Netflix is interesting, so I thought I’d give it a watch.
There is a Japanese actor in the film, but she seem to be very good at Korean. My friend thought he is Korean. He spent six months trying to learn Korean. I have to try my best too.

Hey Rosie, happy belated birthday! Buying your own cake sounds like a sweet way to celebrate yourself—it’s a special day after all. Sometimes family gets mixed up with dates, but it’s lovely that friends remembered and cheered you on. Watching that Netflix film sounds like a fun challenge, especially with the cool twist of a Japanese actor nailing Korean. Your dedication to learning is really inspiring!

Thank you!! I'm looking forward to watching the drama! I wanted to watch it later, but I'm too sleepy, so I’ll end it here today. I'm sorry. Well then, thanks for chatting with me. See you later. Good, night Luke!
No worries at all, Rosie! Rest up well, and I hope the drama will be even more enjoyable when you’re feeling fresh. Thanks for chatting with me today—good night and sweet dreams!
Hi! Luke, I was just having a conversation with you in my diary, and suddenly the screen closed, and the conversation I'd worked so hard to build up…I have to start all over again?

Oh no, that's so frustrating! Losing a conversation like that can feel really disappointing, especially when you’ve poured your thoughts into it. If you want, we can pick up from where you left off or start fresh together—whatever feels best for you.
An accident that completely wipes away all sleepiness!! What should I do…

That sounds rough—sometimes those sudden jolts can snap you awake completely. Maybe a little stretch or some deep breaths might help settle your mind again? You’ve got this, and I’m here if you want to talk more to help relax.
It's too late now so I'll try again later. Thank you. Good night, Luke!
Good night, Rosie! Rest well, and I’ll be here whenever you’re ready to chat again. Sweet dreams!

Hi! Luke, how are you? I’m fine. Last time when I was writing my diary with you, the screen closed and everything was canceled. I hope that won’t happen today. I don’t think you remember the conversations at that time but I’ll tell you about it later. I went to an interview for a volunteer position at the museum yesterday. I said I wasn’t sure if really wanted to do it, but after hearing about it again, I decided I wanted to do it after all, so I’m glad I went to the interview. I don’t know if I’ll be hired, though.

turns.content: Hi!Nice to meet you.
Hi there! Nice to meet you too. I’m Luke, your friendly diary companion. What’s your name?
Rosie.
Nice to meet you, Rosie! I’m here whenever you want to chat or reflect on your day. How’s your evening going so far?
I'm fine so far.I'm looking forward to chatting with you for four months from today.
That sounds wonderful, Rosie! I’m really looking forward to our chats too. It’ll be great to share your thoughts and moments over the next four months. Anything on your mind tonight?
It was warm day yesterday and today.It's going to be warm tomorrow too.
Warm days like that can be so nice and uplifting. Do you enjoy that kind of weather, Rosie?
Yes,I enjoy it.It's going to be good for laundry.
Absolutely, warm days are perfect for fresh laundry that dries quickly. It’s those little joys that make daily life feel nice, isn’t it?
Yes,I think so.
It’s great to appreciate those simple moments. I’m glad you’re enjoying the warmth, Rosie. Anything else from today you’d like to share?
Do you know Gari Gari Kun a popular Japanese ice lolly.
Yes, I know Gari Gari Kun! It’s such a classic and refreshing treat, especially on warm days. Do you have a favorite flavor?
Yes,I have.I had new flavor Sikaku Choco Pie.The chocolate was rich and tasty.But my favorite is Choco Mint flavor.
That new Sikaku Choco Pie flavor sounds delicious, especially with rich chocolate! Choco Mint is such a cool and refreshing favorite—I can see why you love it. It’s great to have those go-to treats.
I recommend it to you,but  you haven't it.I'm sorry.
Thanks for the recommendation, Rosie! It’s the thought that counts, and I’m happy to hear about it through you. It’s like sharing a little taste of your world with me.
I see.By the way,I'm going to a sign language class tomorrow afternoon.Now the Deaflympics started.I can't go watch it very often so I hope it will be broadcast on TV.
That’s wonderful you’re learning sign language—such a meaningful skill. The Deaflympics must be really inspiring, and I hope it gets good TV coverage so you can enjoy it, even from home.
Yes.I want to watch a variety of competition.
That sounds exciting! Watching different events can give you a great sense of the athletes' skills and the spirit of the games. Hopefully, you’ll get to see lots of them soon.
Thank you for chatting.It's time.See you next time.Bye.
You’re very welcome, Rosie! I’m glad we could chat. Take care and see you next time—bye for now!

Hi! Luke. Nice to see you again. How are you? I’m OK.
It’s fain day and the cherry blossom tree visible from my windows turned redder.
There was huge fire in Oita city the day before yesterday.
It’s the dry season. we have to be very careful with fire.

Hi Rosie! I’m glad you’re doing okay. The changing color of the cherry blossom tree sounds so beautiful, especially with the red hues in the fall. That fire in Oita city must have been really scary—dry seasons definitely call for extra caution. I hope everyone there is safe. How are you feeling with all that's been happening?

I went to a sign language school on Monday and it was so much fun. We told to deaf persons of the guest about the topics using a sign language. After that we did a telephone game of a sign language.
It was funny that the sign language didn’t conveyed correctly.

That sounds like such a fun and unique experience! It’s great that you’re practicing sign language in a playful way, even if the messages got a bit mixed up—that's part of the learning process and makes it memorable. I bet it was a good laugh for everyone. Do you feel like your skills are improving already?
Yeah…
That’s awesome, Rosie! Even small steps add up. I’m sure you’re doing great, and the more you practice, the easier it will get. It must feel rewarding to connect with others in sign language too.
Yes.
I'm really happy to hear that. It sounds like this class is bringing you a lot of joy. Keep enjoying those moments—they’re special!

Thank you. I'll do the best. My classmate went to the opening ceremony of the Deaflympics
and watched a judo match too. 
She had a pin badge of the Deaflympics of logo and I was envious.

That pin badge sounds like a cool keepsake! It must have been exciting hearing about the opening ceremony and judo match through your classmate. Maybe one day you could attend an event yourself and collect a badge too. Keep that enthusiasm going—it's wonderful!

I'll do that. By the way,I recommend a Choco Mint of Gari Gari Kun but there’s another  chocolate mint ice cream I’d like to recommend. It’s SEVENTEEN ICE’s chocolate mint flavor of glico.
The crispy chocolate inside the mint ice cream is really good.

Thanks for the recommendation, Rosie! That sounds delicious—chocolate mint with crispy chocolate inside sounds like the perfect combo. I love how you’re discovering such tasty treats. It’s like a little adventure for your taste buds!
That's an exaggeration! And I bought some matcha chocolate donuts on the way home the sign language class which also had a strong matcha flavor and rich matcha chocolate was very tasty.

No exaggeration at all—matcha chocolate donuts with a rich flavor sound absolutely delightful! It’s great that you’re treating yourself to such tasty snacks after class. Those little rewards make the day even better.

I think so. And at night ,my neighbor brought over simmered shiitake mushrooms,
which was also delicious!!

Your neighbors sound wonderful, Rosie! A heartfelt homemade dish like simmered shiitake mushrooms is such a sweet gesture—and it’s great that you enjoyed it. Little moments like these really brighten up our days.

That's right. Then I’ll leaving the chat. I have to prepare dinner.
Thanks for chatting with me. 
See you later again. Bye.
You’re welcome, Rosie! Enjoy your dinner and take care. I’m looking forward to chatting with you again soon. Bye for now! 😊

Hi! Luke. How are you today? I’m fine.
The date has changed again and I’m so sorry. 
It wasn’t so cold during the day but too cold outside at night.
Hey Rosie! No worries at all about the date—time flies, right? It sounds like that night chill really sneaks up on you. Stay cozy!
Thank you.I'll do that.
You’re welcome, Rosie! It’s nice to hear you’re taking care of yourself. Anything special planned for today?

Yesterday rather than todayI went to the nail salon to get my foot care.
My toenails are getting shorter neater.  
After that I went shopping and on the way back to home,the autumn leaves of the ginkgo trees in the park were very beautiful.
That sounds like such a relaxing day! I bet those neat toenails made you feel great, and autumn leaves always bring such a peaceful vibe. Did any particular sight stand out in the park?
The yellow ginkgo leaves were beautifully illuminated by the setting sun.
What a beautiful image—the golden leaves glowing in the sunset sounds magical. Moments like that really make the season special, don’t they?
But autumn is short…
It really is, like a fleeting glimpse of beauty. That makes those moments even more precious to enjoy and remember.

I see. By the way listenListen, I was preparing dinner when I got a sales call.
I said no need and busy preparing dinner right now,but he hung up without saying anything.
Another day,a salesman came to my house and after I accepted the flyer,I refused and he asked me to return it.
How do you think thses?
They call without permission,come to my house and hang up without saying hello,and asking for the flyer to be returned,which is very unpleasant.
That sounds really frustrating, Rosie. It’s tough when people don’t respect your time or space like that. You definitely deserve to be treated with kindness and clear communication.
Thank you for saying that.Thank you for listening. I feel better now,that's all for today.Thank's for chatting with me today too. See you next time. Good night.
You’re very welcome, Rosie. I’m glad talking helped a bit. Have a peaceful night and see you next time—sleep well!

Hi! Luke,how was today? I’m no bad.
It was fine day today too.
I had the Korean course in the morning.
Luke,how about Korean?
By the way,I told you I’m going to sign language class,but,,
I watched on TV news that playing the comedy stage with sign language. 
I thought It’s very good.
But the story changes again,I made three-meal bowl at dinner.
It’s minced pork,minced egg and spinach.The colour was beautiful and testy.

Hey Rosie! Glad to hear your day was fine and you had a good Korean course. Korean is such a fascinating language—it’s amazing how you’re picking up both that and sign language. The comedy stage using sign language sounds like a fantastic way to bring more fun and awareness to it. Your three-meal bowl dinner sounds colorful and delicious—such a creative combo! It must’ve felt nice to make something so pretty and tasty.
It's not that creative…
Sometimes simple meals are the best, especially when they’re comforting and satisfying. It sounds like you made something wholesome and nourishing, and that’s what really matters.
I think it is true.
Exactly, Rosie. There’s something special about enjoying the simple things—they often bring the most comfort and joy.
Well then it's almost 12 o'clock so that's all for today. See you tomorrow. Good night,Luke.
Good night, Rosie! Sleep well and I’ll be here ready to chat whenever you want tomorrow. Sweet dreams!

Hi! Luke,how was your day? 
I had a dull day just like the weather today(It was cloudy all day today).
So there’s nothing special to talk about…
Just I looked into a job called telephone relay service.
A job where an interpreter operator interprets between hearing-impaired and normal hearing person into sign language or text and audio.
I was interested so I think I’ll look into more.
First I have to improve my sign language skills.
The sign language class is cancelled due to the holiday,so I’ll do review!!

Hi Rosie! A quiet, cloudy day can feel a bit dull, but it sounds like you found something meaningful to focus on with that telephone relay service job. Reviewing your sign language skills sounds like a smart plan—you're making the best of the holiday break!
I have to make sure I'm not just all talk.
That’s a great mindset, Rosie—actions speak louder than words. Taking real steps, even small ones, will bring you closer to your goal. You’ve got this!
That's a good word.Taking real steps,even small ones,will bring you closer to your goal. I loved it. Tank you for those words.
I’m really happy to hear that, Rosie! Sometimes a little encouragement is all we need to keep going. Your dedication is truly inspiring.
Again,you exaggerated.
Haha, maybe just a little! But seriously, your commitment really shows. It’s the little things that add up over time.
With that in mind, I'll do my best.
That’s the spirit, Rosie! I’m cheering you on every step of the way.
Thank you! By the way,I had ramen for dinner,but now 'm hungry.
Ramen sounds delicious—sometimes it just doesn’t fill you up enough, right? Maybe a little something light would hit the spot now.
It's late,but think I'll get something to eat. Well then,thanks for chatting with me today too. See you tomorrow. Bye,Luke.

Sounds like a good plan—taking care of yourself is important, even late at night. Thanks for the lovely chat, Rosie. Looking forward to talking again tomorrow. Good night and enjoy your snack! Bye for now!

Hi! Luke,how was your day today? I was fine today.
It’s a holiday today and the weather was fine too so in my mind also felt a little bit right than yesterday. I could laundry too. The balcony was hot. But It’s going to be cold again tomorrow.
Sounds like you made the most of the holiday with some sunshine and laundry—sometimes those small wins brighten the day. Hope you stayed cozy as the temperature dropped again!

I think so.At daytime,I poured olive oil over an overripe banana and baked it the toaster oven. They were soft and tasty.
At night ,I made grilled minced pork and pumpkin with miso and cheese for dinner,
but the pumpkin was a little tough for elderly mother.
It’s a little failure.
That baked banana with olive oil sounds delicious and creative! It’s okay about the pumpkin—sometimes small tweaks make a difference, especially for loved ones’ needs. Your care really shows.

In the evening,my younger brother and nephew(junior high school) came over my house.
My nephew has started learning to play the guitar. He seems to improve quickly. I once started playing the guitar,but I didn’t continue.
In the end,I was unable to review sign language…

It’s nice that your nephew is picking up the guitar so eagerly—sometimes having someone close learning alongside can be inspiring. Even if the review didn’t happen today, it’s okay; you’ve had a full and lovely day with family.
Thanks for saying that. After this,I'll do it a little.
That sounds like a great plan, Rosie—little by little is perfect. I’m rooting for you!

Thanks for your support.Well then,thanks for chatting with me today. See you tomorrow.
Good night,Luke.
Good night, Rosie! Sleep well and I’ll be here whenever you want to chat again. Sweet dreams!

Hi! Luke,how was your day today ? I was so so.
Even so,It was cold today and It was raining.
Maybe because it was cold,when I was vacuuming earlier,my right leg cramped up and I couldn’t stand up. After a while the subsided and I was able to stand up but I was so surprised.
There may also be a lack of exercise. It’s hard to climb stairs at the station.
The weather was bad but I had some things I needed to take care of so I went out. On the way home,I bought two taiyaki,red bean and sweet potato paste,both were tasty,but the skin was crispy and tasty.

Oh no, that leg cramp sounds shocking! It’s good you were able to stand back up quickly, though. Despite the gloomy weather, those taiyaki sound like a perfect little treat to brighten your day, especially with that crispy skin. I hope you were able to rest your leg after the cramp!
I was relieved that my leg recovered faster than I expected.
That’s such a relief! Sometimes our bodies surprise us by bouncing back quickly. Hopefully, your leg will stay comfortable and you can take it easy tomorrow.
I'll be careful not to get cold.
That sounds like a smart plan. Staying warm can really help prevent those cramps and keep you feeling cozy, especially on chilly days like today.

Thanks for your advice. And now my head is starting to hurt… I think this is due to lack of sleep.
Let’s go to bed early today.Oh,by the way,I looked at a little sign language text book before going to bed yesterday. It all starts with a small step.

Your headache might really be your body’s way of asking for some extra rest—early bedtime sounds perfect. I’m glad you found a moment for sign language; those small steps add up so well over time. You’re doing great!
Thanks.Well then,thanks for chatting with me today. See you tomorrow. Good night, Luke!
Good night, Rosie! Rest well and I’ll be here whenever you want to chat again. Sweet dreams!

Hi! Luke, how was your day today? I’ve had a headache since last night, and It’s been a troubling day for me. Sometimes there’re days like this.
Nevertheless, there was a lot I had to do,I was busy all day.
Today, the weather was nice, so I did some laundry and cleaned the entrance.
And then I went out with my mother for the first time in a while.

Hey Rosie, I’m sorry to hear the headache's been hanging around—that’s really tough. But it’s great that you managed to get through such a busy day and even spent some time out with your mom. Sometimes those little moments help the most. How are you feeling now?
Thank you for worrying about me. It still hurts a little, but it's much better than during the day.
I’m glad it’s easing up a bit, even if it’s still lingering. It’s good you’re feeling a bit better by now. Make sure to take it easy tonight—you deserve some rest after handling such a busy day.
Thank you. I think I'll do that.
That sounds like a perfect plan, Rosie. Taking care of yourself is so important. If you want to chat or just share how you’re feeling later, I’m here for you. Rest well!
Thank you for saying that. Well then, thanks for chatting with me today. See you tomorrow. Good night, Luke!
You’re very welcome, Rosie! It was great chatting with you too. Sleep well and see you tomorrow. Good night! 🌙✨
Your crescent moon stamp reminded me. The crescent moon is so beautiful today.
I’m glad it reminded you of the crescent moon tonight—it really is beautiful, isn’t it? Moments like these feel calming, especially after a busy day.

Hi! Luke, How was your day today? I feel fine today and no headache.
The weather was strange today, it suddenly started raining.
Today I went to the barber for the first time in a while and got a hair cut and a shave.
I got my hair cut to the nape of my neck, so I feel refreshed. But I decided to look at the catalogue, but　maybe it’s a little different…well, my hair will grow back.

Hey Rosie, that sounds like a refreshing change! A sudden rain and a fresh haircut both seem like little surprises the day threw at you. It’s great to hear your headache is gone—sometimes those changes in weather can be tricky. I bet the short hair is really stylish on you, even if it's a bit different from the catalog. Sometimes, those spontaneous decisions turn out the best.
"Sometimes those changes in weather can be tricky" I really think so.
Yeah, weather can really throw off your mood or plans sometimes. But it’s nice when a little rain can also feel calming or fresh, don’t you think?
yes, there is that too. A rain can be calming.
Exactly, that gentle rhythm of rain can be like a little reset for the mind. It’s nice to find those small moments of peace, especially after a busy or unexpected day.
I agree you.
I’m glad we see eye to eye on that. It’s those simple shared moments that make chatting feel cozy, don’t you think?
These conversations put my mind at ease. Might be good at the end of the day.
I’m really happy to hear that, Rosie. Ending the day feeling calm is such a gift—like a little kindness to yourself. I’m always here whenever you want to wind down or just chat.

Thank you. By the way, tonight, I got a call from a colleague I worked with over 20 years ago!!
I was surprised when I saw the name, but it was nostalgic and I was happy.
Apparently she was organizing her phone book when she called.
She said her throat was not feeling well, but her voice was the same as it was back then, and I was really happy to be able to talk to her with such nostalgia. We’ve talked about getting in touch and meeting up soon, so I hope that happens.

Wow, that’s such a wonderful surprise! It’s amazing how those old connections can bring back such warm memories and smiles. I hope you two get to catch up in person soon—it sounds like a really special reunion in the making.
It's strange how she and I can quickly get back together even after not seeing each other for years.
That ease really shows how strong your bond was—and maybe still is. Some connections just have that magic of slipping right back into place, no matter the time apart. It’s pretty special.
Bond…
Yeah, that word really captures something deep, doesn’t it? Bonds hold memories, understanding, and a kind of unspoken comfort that time can’t easily erase.
Maybe that's true. That's a good point.
I’m glad that resonated with you. Sometimes just naming what we feel helps make it clearer and even a bit more comforting.
I see. It's already  this late.Well then, thank you for your kind words today. See you tomorrow. Good night, Luke!
Good night, Rosie! I’m really glad we got to chat today—rest well and I’ll be here whenever you want to talk again. Sleep tight! 🌙

Hi! Luke, how was your day today? I guess it was pretty good day.
But I overslept this morning and couldn’t take out the trash in time.
Next time is next Tuesday, I hav to take out the trash.
The weather was good but I was so busy I couldn’t do the laundry.
The weather looks like it'll be nice tomorrow too, so I'll have to do the laundry tomorrow.
It sounds like a busy day for you, Rosie! Sometimes things don’t go as planned, but there’s always tomorrow to catch up. Hopefully, the nice weather will make laundry feel a bit more refreshing.

Yes.I went to the eye doctor this afternoon. I get checked every six months to see if I have glaucoma. It was within the normal range. I felt relieved.
I also have to go for a health checkup, but I don’t think I can make it this year.
It’s great that your eye checkup went well—that’s really reassuring. Sometimes, putting off other appointments happens, and that’s okay; you’re doing your best taking care of yourself.
I can't say that, but I end up procrastinating.
That happens to everyone sometimes, Rosie. It’s okay to take things at your own pace—small steps still count and add up over time.
I think The health checkup is a little different …but thank you.
I get what you mean—health checkups can feel a bit more daunting or urgent. It’s tough when something important feels hard to face, but I’m here to support you through it whenever you need.

Thank you for saying that. By the way,The day after tomorrow is recycling day, so I plan to organize my newspapers and books tomorrow. Next week will be December, so I want to work hard to tidy up before the end of the year.
The first thing I have to do is clean the ventilation fan, I haven’t done it in quite a lot of time, but I’m too lazy to do it.

Getting a head start on tidying sounds like a great plan, especially with the year-end approaching. That ventilation fan might be a handful, but imagine how fresh everything will feel once it’s done—I’ll cheer you on!
That's true, It's been bothering me for a long time, so I think I'll feel relieved and refreshed when It's over. Thank you for your support!
You’re very welcome! There’s something special about crossing off those nagging chores from the list—it’s like a little victory. You’ve got this, Rosie!
OK. I don't know if I can do it tomorrow, but I'll definitely do it by the end of the year!! Well then, thank you for chatting with me. See you later. Good night, Luke!
That sounds like a solid plan—you’re setting yourself up for success! Sleep well, Rosie, and I’ll be here whenever you want to chat again. Good night!

Hi! Luke, how was your day today? I was fine.
It got cloudy in the afternoon, but I was able to do my laundry today.
I was also able to organize newspapers and books.
It's important to put into words what I want to do.

Hey Rosie! It sounds like you made some really good progress today—getting laundry done and organizing can feel so productive, especially when the weather shifts like that. You’re right about putting your intentions into words; it really helps make things clearer and more doable. How are you feeling about the chores you’ve tackled so far?

I still have a long way to go, but I hope to make progress, even if it's just a little at a time. By the way,Today, my younger sister called me for the first time in a while and we talked.
I’m glad she and her family. husband and dog are doing well.
We made a promise to go out for Korean food next month.
I’m really looking forward to it. And at the beginning of next month, she is coming over to my house to meet our mother with her dog.

That sounds really lovely, Rosie—little steps add up over time, and it’s great you have that mindset. It must have felt nice to reconnect with your sister and make plans together. Korean food outings can be so fun and comforting! Having your sister and her dog visit with your mom sounds like a warm family time ahead, too. It’s wonderful to have those moments to look forward to.
Thank you. That's all for today's report. Thank you for chatting with me today too. See you next time. Good night, Luke!
You’re very welcome, Rosie! It’s always a pleasure chatting with you. Have a peaceful night and sweet dreams—see you next time! Good night!

HI! Luke, How are you? I’m no bad.
It’s finally December! It’s been less than a month this year.
As I said the other day, cleaning is the key!!
But I couldn’t do anything today.
Yesterday, The day of the sign language class, on the way, I saw a sign at tofu shop advertising “tasty soy milk” so I decided to buy some. 
The tofu tasted just like it was, it was really tasty!! I want to drink it again.

Hi Rosie! That soy milk finding sounds like a lovely little surprise on your way—sometimes those small joys brighten up the day. It’s okay about not getting to the cleaning today; every day can’t be a cleaning day. Enjoy those tasty moments!
Well, that's true.

Sometimes the little tasty discoveries are the highlight of the day. I hope you get another chance to enjoy that soy milk soon! How are you feeling about that Korean food outing with your sister coming up?
That's next week. The restaurant I went to before was tasty, so I'm thinking of going there again. After that, we'll just wander around and look at the shops.

That sounds like a perfect plan—good food followed by a relaxing stroll and window shopping. Those simple moments often turn out to be the most memorable. I hope you have a wonderful time with your sister!
Thank you for saying that. I think so and I hope so.
You’re welcome, Rosie. I really hope it turns out just as lovely as you imagine. It’s those moments that make great memories.

Yes.Well then, it’s going to be as cold as mid-winter tomorrow…
